newsitem.title: BOSNIA: Bosnia Feb PPI down 0.2 pct m/m, 6.4 pct y/y.
newsitem.headline: Bosnia Feb PPI down 0.2 pct m/m, 6.4 pct y/y.

text.p: The Statistics Bureau of Bosnia's Moslem-Croat federation issued the following economic indicator details on Monday.
INDUSTRIAL PRODUCER PRICES FEB JAN FEB 96

NOTES -- The data cover 51 percent of Bosnia-Hercegovina territory. Data for the Bosnian Serb republic are not available. Bosnian industrial producer prices rose in Jan-Feb 1997 period by 6.5 percent compared to the same period in 1996, the office said. -- Sarajevo newsroom, +387-71-663-864.
